# SectionLinkOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`SectionLink`](section-link.md). Intersects [`HyperlinkOptions`](hyperlink-options.md).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type SectionLinkOptions = HyperlinkOptions & Partial<Pick<SectionLink, 'anchorTarget'>>
```

## Properties

- [`anchorTarget`](#anchortarget): The anchor id this link jumps to (a `Section` or anchored `Heading`).
- [`color`](#color): Link text colour.
- [`fontName`](#fontname): Gets or sets the font name for the link text
- [`fontSize`](#fontsize): Font size.
- [`margin`](#margin): Margin around the link.
- [`targetPageIndex`](#targetpageindex): Gets or sets the target 0-based page index (for internal links)
- [`text`](#text): Gets the link text to display
- [`underline`](#underline): Draws a line under the link text, in the link colour, placed as an underline decoration on text is.
- [`uri`](#uri): Gets or sets the URI (URL) that this hyperlink points to

### `anchorTarget`

```typescript
anchorTarget?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

The anchor id this link jumps to (a [`Section`](section.md) or anchored [`Heading`](heading.md)).

### `color`

```typescript
color?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Link text colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `fontName`

```typescript
fontName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Gets or sets the font name for the link text

### `fontSize`

```typescript
fontSize?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Font size. Accepts a length: `12`, `'12pt'`, `'4mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around the link. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`.

### `targetPageIndex`

```typescript
targetPageIndex?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Gets or sets the target 0-based page index (for internal links)

### `text`

```typescript
text?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Gets the link text to display

### `underline`

```typescript
underline?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Draws a line under the link text, in the link colour, placed as an underline decoration on text is. Default `false`.

### `uri`

```typescript
uri?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Gets or sets the URI (URL) that this hyperlink points to
